categories.main_business_segments: Taiwan Paiho Limited primarily engages in the production and sales of various functional textile accessories including hook and loop fasteners, woven tapes (shoelaces), elastic bands, injection molded hooks, woven jacquard fabrics, warp and weft knitted jacquard mesh fabrics, and other textile fabrics. The company also provides diverse processing services such as bamboo charcoal yarn functional fibers, medical protective gear, 3C accessories, automotive and aerospace component assembly, and real estate development through entrusted contractors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced weaving and knitting technologies including precision warp knitting and jacquard weaving machines. Injection molded hooks are produced via continuous extrusion molding with capabilities for coloring, computer printing, and high-frequency welding without sewing. The production process integrates automated and semi-automated equipment to improve efficiency and reduce labor costs. The company also emphasizes environmentally friendly processes such as glue-free manufacturing and uses certified recycled materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taiwan Paiho serves a broad range of industries including footwear, apparel, sports equipment, medical devices, rehabilitation aids, stationery, toys, furniture accessories, 3C peripherals, automotive, aerospace, disposable products like diapers and surgical gowns, and military applications. Its customers are mainly international brands in the mid-to-high-end market segments, with strong recognition in the global footwear and garment industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production and sales facilities in Taiwan, China (Jiangsu and Dongguan), Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City and Binh Duong), Indonesia, and North America (USA). It maintains a global footprint with service points near international brand headquarters, including a service office in Portland, USA, to provide localized and integrated customer support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taiwan Paiho operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile and accessory supply chain, producing functional textile materials and components. It integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream product design, processing, and assembly services, offering comprehensive ODM solutions and collaborating closely with brand customers to provide end-to-end product development and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in sustainable and functional textile materials, focusing on eco-friendly products incorporating recycled yarns, glue-free processes, and non-toxic waterproof breathable membranes. R&D efforts target new product development such as waterproof jacquard shoe uppers, biomimetic double-layer knitted elastic bands, and ultra-thin adhesive labels. It also emphasizes automation, energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and digital marketing platforms to enhance competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of textile accessories and functional fabrics, complemented by processing and assembly services. The company also engages in real estate sales through entrusted contractors. Its business model includes ODM services, providing integrated design and manufacturing solutions to international brand customers, with a focus on high-value-added and diversified product offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taiwan Paiho holds a leading position in the functional textile accessories industry, distinguished by its comprehensive product range, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and global production footprint. While the market has many competitors, most focus on single product lines with varying quality. Paiho’s ability to offer full-process solutions, extensive R&D, and close collaboration with major international brands provides it with a strong competitive advantage and market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$15.46 billion, a 24.2% increase from the prior year, with net profit attributable to owners of NT$1.42 billion, up 143.7%. The company’s total assets reached NT$32.74 billion, and equity attributable to owners was NT$16.52 billion, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability. R&D investment accounted for about 3.3% of revenue, supporting ongoing innovation and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taiwan Paiho emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and sustainable textile accessories that meet stringent international environmental and safety standards such as RSL, REACH, and RoHS. Its products combine functionality, durability, and aesthetic appeal, supported by advanced manufacturing and processing technologies. The company’s global presence and integrated service model enable rapid, localized support and collaborative product development, delivering unique value and reliability to leading global brands.
